# tailwind_combine v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

Utility function to efficiently merge Tailwind CSS classes in Elixir without style conflicts.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://tailwind-combine.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [TailwindCombine](https://tailwind-combine.hexdocs.pm/TailwindCombine.md): Merge Tailwind CSS classes in Elixir without style conflicts.
- [TailwindCombine.Config](https://tailwind-combine.hexdocs.pm/TailwindCombine.Config.md): Provides config.

- [TailwindCombine.Validator](https://tailwind-combine.hexdocs.pm/TailwindCombine.Validator.md): Provides built-in validators.
